_comment: Median wall-clock ceiling in seconds for recent successful push runs on main, per workflow (release.yml runs only on tags and has none). check_ci_budget.py fails when a workflow's median exceeds its ceiling. Set on 2026-11-10 at the ten-push medians, which predate the set-up step cuts; lower them once ten pushes carry those cuts. Raise a number only with a reason in the commit body; the point of the file is that slowdown is a decision, not drift.

setup_step._comment: Ceiling in seconds for any one set-up step (a step whose name starts with one of the prefixes). The weekly check fails on a step whose median over the sampled push runs is over; each push's budget job warns on its own. Cut a slow step by eliminating, prebuilding or caching it; exempt a step only with the reason none of those can.

exempt.CodeQL · java-kotlin / Install Android b: Hosted runner: the repository's GitHub cache is at its 10 GB limit and an NDK entry would evict the Gradle caches; Security analysis is off the push's critical path.
exempt.CodeQL · java-kotlin / Set up Android SD: Hosted runner: setup-android downloads its pinned command-line tools there, and caching them would add to a GitHub cache already at its 10 GB limit; Security analysis is off the push's critical path.
exempt.Initialize CodeQL: The hosted image's tool cache lags the CodeQL bundle the action pins, so init downloads it; using the older cached bundle would run older queries, and Security analysis is off the push's critical path.
exempt.Release Gradle cache / Install Android b: Hosted on purpose, to fill the GitHub-hosted Gradle cache the release workflow restores; an SDK entry would evict that cache, and the job is off the push's critical path.
exempt.Release Gradle cache / Set up Android SD: Hosted on purpose, to fill the GitHub-hosted Gradle cache the release workflow restores; an SDK entry would evict that cache, and the job is off the push's critical path.
